questions.question: `.git/objects/` dagi to'rt asosiy obyekt turini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Blob: faqat fayl mazmuni (zlib bilan siqilgan) — nomi, papka va ruxsatsiz.

questions.question: Git'ning "uch daraxti" (uch hudud) nima?
questions.explanation: Working directory: diskdagi siz tahrirlayotgan fayllar.

questions.question: `git add` ichkarida qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Fayl mazmunini zlib bilan siqib, hash nomli blob obyektini .git/objects/ ga yozadi.

questions.question: `git commit` ichkarida qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Index'dagi papkalar uchun tree obyektlarini yozadi.

questions.question: Git'da `HEAD` va "detached HEAD" nima?
questions.explanation: HEAD: joriy branch'ga ishora qiluvchi simvolik ref (ref: refs/heads/main).

questions.question: `git merge` va `git rebase` farqi.
questions.explanation: merge: ikki tarixni birlashtiruvchi merge commit yaratadi — tarix o'zgarmaydi, haqiqiy kontekst saqlanadi.

questions.question: Fast-forward va three-way merge (`--no-ff`) farqi.
questions.explanation: Fast-forward: target branch'da ajralgandan keyin yangi commit bo'lmasa, Git shunchaki pointer'ni oldinga suradi — merge commit yo'q.

questions.question: `git cherry-pick` nima va qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Boshqa branch'dagi aniq commit kiritgan diff'ni joriy branch'ga qo'llab, yangi SHA va vaqtli yangi commit yaratadi (masalan hotfix'ni release branch'ga).

questions.question: `git revert` va `git reset` farqi.
questions.explanation: revert <commit> (umumiy branch uchun xavfsiz): commit diff'ining teskarisini qo'llovchi yangi commit — tarix saqlanadi.

questions.question: `git reset --soft`, `--mixed` va `--hard` farqi.
questions.explanation: soft: faqat branch'ni orqaga suradi; index va working directory o'zgarmaydi (o'zgarishlar staged qoladi).

questions.question: `git reflog` nima va avariyadan tiklashda qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Lokal repo'da HEAD har safar siljiganini (commit, checkout, rebase, reset) yozadigan lokal jurnal (default ~90 kun).

questions.question: `git stash` nima va `stash pop` bilan `stash apply` farqi?
questions.explanation: Commit qilinmagan o'zgarishlarni ichki stack'ka (stash@{0}) vaqtincha olib qo'yadi:

questions.question: `git bisect` nima va debug'ni qanday avtomatlashtiradi?
questions.explanation: Yaxshi va yomon commit orasida binary search bilan regressiyani kiritgan aniq commit'ni topadi (log₂N qadamda):

questions.question: `git clean` nima?
questions.explanation: Kuzatilmayotgan (untracked) fayllarni o'chiradi (git clean -fd — fayl va papkalar; avval -n bilan dry-run).

questions.question: `.gitignore` nima va nega allaqachon kuzatilayotgan faylni e'tiborsiz qoldirmaydi?
questions.explanation: gitignore faqat untracked fayllarga ta'sir qiladi. Fayl avval commit qilingan bo'lsa Git uni kuzatishda davom etadi — avval git rm --cached <file> qilish kerak (tarixda baribir qoladi).

questions.question: `git submodule` va `git subtree` farqi.
questions.explanation: submodule: tashqi repo'ning aniq commit SHA'siga ishora qiluvchi mustaqil ichki repo (alohida clone/update kerak).

questions.question: `git commit --amend` nima?
questions.explanation: Staged o'zgarishlarni oxirgi commit bilan birlashtirib, xabar, tree va SHA'ni qayta yozadi. Faqat push qilinmagan lokal commit'larda.

questions.question: `git pull` va `git fetch` farqi.
questions.explanation: fetch: remote commit, branch va tag'larni lokal .git ga yuklaydi, ishchi fayllarni o'zgartirmaydi.

questions.question: `git blame` nima?
questions.explanation: Faylning har qatoriga uni oxirgi o'zgartirgan commit hash'i, muallif va vaqtni yozadi (-w, -C bilan bo'shliq va ko'chirishlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish).

questions.question: `git log --graph --oneline --decorate --all` nima?
questions.explanation: Branch topologiyasi, merge nuqtalari, tag va commit'larni ixcham ASCII grafda ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: `git diff` va `git diff --staged` farqi.
questions.explanation: git diff: working directory va index orasidagi (unstaged) farq.

questions.question: Git plumbing va porcelain buyruqlari farqi.
questions.explanation: Porcelain: kundalik yuqori darajali buyruqlar (add, commit, merge, checkout).

questions.question: `git cat-file` nima?
questions.explanation: Xom Git obyektlarini ko'rish:

questions.question: `git hash-object` nima?
questions.explanation: Fayl mazmunining hash'ini hisoblaydi va -w bilan uni blob sifatida .git/objects/ ga yozadi.

questions.question: Git reference (`ref`) nima?
questions.explanation: git/refs/ ostidagi commit SHA'sini saqlovchi oddiy fayl (.git/refs/heads/main — main ning uchi); ko'plari packed-refs ga ham jamlanadi.

questions.question: Simvolik reference (`symref`) nima?
questions.explanation: SHA emas, boshqa ref'ga ishora qiluvchi ref (.git/HEAD — ref: refs/heads/main).

questions.question: Remote-tracking branch (`refs/remotes/origin/main`) nima?
questions.explanation: Oxirgi fetch paytidagi remote branch holatini saqlovchi lokal read-only belgi.

questions.question: Git konfiguratsiya ierarxiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Oshib boruvchi ustunlik bilan:

questions.question: `git remote` bilan remote'larni qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: git remote add upstream <url> — qo'shimcha remote (fork workflow).

questions.question: Lightweight va annotated tag farqi.
questions.explanation: Lightweight: commit SHA'ga oddiy ko'rsatkich (git tag v1.0).

questions.question: `git checkout`, `git switch` va `git restore` farqi (Git 2.23+).
questions.explanation: checkout — branch almashtirish va fayl tiklash uchun "ortiqcha yuklangan".

questions.question: `git shortlog` nima?
questions.explanation: Commit'larni muallif bo'yicha guruhlab soni va sarlavhalarini ko'rsatadi (-sn — hissa reytingi).

questions.question: `git show` nima?
questions.explanation: Commit yoki tag metadata'si, muallif va kiritgan to'liq diff'ini ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: `git status -s` nima?
questions.explanation: Holatni ixcham 2 ustunli formatda (M o'zgargan, A qo'shilgan, ?? untracked) — chap ustun index, o'ng ustun working tree.

questions.question: `git archive` nima?
questions.explanation: Aniq commit yoki tag'dagi daraxtni .git siz zip/tar arxivga eksport qiladi (git archive -o release.zip HEAD).

questions.question: `git bundle` nima?
questions.explanation: Branch va tarixni bitta ko'chma faylga jamlaydi — internetsiz (air-gapped) Git uzatish.

questions.question: `git update-ref` nima?
questions.explanation: HEAD ni siljitmasdan ref'ni aniq SHA'ga xavfsiz yangilash yoki yaratish uchun plumbing buyruq.

questions.question: `git rev-parse` nima?
questions.explanation: Branch, tag yoki nisbiy revision'larni (HEAD~3, main^2) to'liq commit SHA'ga aylantiradi (--show-toplevel kabi foydali opsiyalar ham).

questions.question: `git merge-base` nima?
questions.explanation: Ikki branch'ning eng yaxshi umumiy ajdod commit'ini topadi — 3-way merge shunga asoslanadi.

questions.question: `git describe` nima?
questions.explanation: Commit'dan erishiladigan eng yaqin annotated tag'ni topib, qo'shimcha commit soni va qisqa hash qo'shadi (v1.4.0-12-g2a1b3c) — build versiyasi uchun.

questions.question: `git rm` va `git rm --cached` farqi.
questions.explanation: git rm <file> — index'dan ham, diskdan ham o'chiradi.

questions.question: `git mv` nima?
questions.explanation: Faylni qayta nomlaydi/ko'chiradi va o'zgarishni stage qiladi (Git rename'ni aslida mazmun o'xshashligi bo'yicha aniqlaydi).

questions.question: `git ls-files` nima?
questions.explanation: Index'da kuzatilayotgan fayllar ro'yxati (--others, --ignored bilan boshqalar).

questions.question: `git ls-tree` nima?
questions.explanation: Tree obyekt mazmunini (mode, tur, SHA, nom) chiqaradi (git ls-tree HEAD).

questions.question: `git write-tree` nima?
questions.explanation: Index'ning joriy holatidan tree obyekt yaratib .git/objects/ ga yozadi.

questions.question: `git commit-tree` nima?
questions.explanation: Tree SHA, parent SHA'lar va xabardan commit obyekt yaratadi (branch'ni siljitmaydi).

questions.question: `git pack-objects` va packfile (`.pack` / `.idx`) nima?
questions.explanation: Git loose obyektlarni delta compression bilan bitta packfile'ga siqadi; .idx tez binary qidiruv uchun indeks.

questions.question: `git unpack-objects` nima?
questions.explanation: pack arxivdan alohida loose obyektlarni chiqaradi.

questions.question: `git count-objects` nima?
questions.explanation: Loose va packed obyektlar sonini va repo egallagan disk hajmini ko'rsatadi (-vH).
